insight: Built by Butterfly Effect, the Chinese startup that later launched the viral autonomous agent Manus.
name: Monica
tagline: All-in-one AI assistant sidebar for any browser tab.
description: Monica is an all-in-one AI assistant that lives in a browser side-panel and across mobile and desktop apps, bundling chat, search, writing, translation, and page or video summarization. It aggregates many frontier models — plus image and video generation — into one subscription that works alongside any webpage.

modelSupport.notes: Aggregates many frontier models in one subscription.

edge: Goes past a browser sidebar into full mobile/desktop apps with image and video generation in one bundled subscription.
pros: Bundles many frontier models in one plan
